newsitem.title: GERMANY: Bilfinger sees group output of 9 bln DM.
newsitem.headline: Bilfinger sees group output of 9 bln DM.

text.p: German construction company Bilfinger + Berger AG said on Monday group output was expected to be more than nine billion marks ($5.8 billion), up from 8.6 billion marks in 1995.
But orders were expected to fall short of last year's level.
Bilfinger said the 1996 results would be compared against a strong 1995, when it had group profits of 105.5 million marks.

"Because of the difficult domestic situation, orders will not quite reach the level of last year," the company said in a statement. "Overseas business is seeing positive development, while the domestic market is falling."
In the first 10 months of 1996, new orders rose 2.5 percent to 8.3 billion marks, while orders on hand stood at just over 10 billion marks.
